   grep -l "baseline\|calibrat" /root/contamcal-irt-calibration/*.py 2>/dev/null
   ```

   done
   ```

   ls /root/autodl-tmp/exp006/pooled_irt_all_scales/arc_challenge/ 2>/dev/null
